heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 101–624, title XV, § 1571, Nov. 28, 1990, 104 Stat. 3702

notes.text: Section 5211, Pub. L. 100–418, title IV, § 4201, Aug. 23, 1988, 102 Stat. 1390, related to annual reports by Secretary of Agriculture on long-term agricultural trade strategy. See section 5711 of this title.

Section 5212, Pub. L. 100–418, title IV, § 4202, Aug. 23, 1988, 102 Stat. 1391, directed Secretary of Agriculture to provide technical services to United States Trade Representative on matters concerning agricultural trade. See section 5675 of this title.
